statement.ru: Мария-Антуанетта советовала голодным есть пирожные вместо хлеба.
statement.en: Marie Antoinette told the hungry to eat cake instead of bread.

why: The phrase is from Rousseau (1765); there is no evidence she ever said it.

statement.ru: Наполеон в молодости написал любовную повесть.
statement.en: As a young man, Napoleon wrote a romance novella.

why: Clisson et Eugénie, a romantic novella written by Napoleon in 1795.

statement.ru: Пираты часто казнили пленников, заставляя их пройти по доске за борт.
statement.en: Pirates often executed captives by making them walk the plank.

why: Only a few cases are documented, all after the Golden Age of Piracy; it is mostly fiction.

statement.ru: Юный Людовик XIV сам танцевал в балете роль Солнца.
statement.en: As a teenager, Louis XIV himself danced the role of the Sun in a ballet.

why: In the 1653 Ballet Royal de la Nuit the 14-year-old king danced Apollo, the Sun.

statement.ru: Доктор Гильотен, давший имя гильотине, сам был на ней казнён.
statement.en: Doctor Guillotin, who gave the guillotine its name, was himself executed on it.

why: Guillotin died at home in Paris in 1814 of natural causes.

statement.ru: По пиратскому уставу за потерю руки или ноги полагалась выплата.
statement.en: Under pirate articles, a man who lost an arm or a leg was paid compensation.

why: Bartholomew Roberts' articles paid 800 pieces of eight for a lost limb.

statement.ru: Генрих VIII сочинил песню «Зелёные рукава».
statement.en: Henry VIII wrote the song Greensleeves.

why: A common myth; the song is in an Italian style that reached England after his death.

statement.ru: Леонардо да Винчи писал заметки зеркально — справа налево.
statement.en: Leonardo da Vinci wrote his notes in mirror writing, right to left.

why: Leonardo wrote most of his personal notes in mirror script.

statement.ru: Галилея сожгли на костре за то, что Земля вертится.
statement.en: Galileo was burned at the stake for saying that the Earth moves.

why: He was forced to recant and spent the rest of his life under house arrest; he died in 1642 of natural causes.

statement.ru: В завещании Шекспир оставил жене свою «вторую по качеству кровать».
statement.en: In his will Shakespeare left his wife his 'second-best bed'.

why: His only bequest to Anne was his 'second-best bed with the furniture'.

statement.ru: Гай Фокс, чья маска стала символом протеста, хотел взорвать парламент.
statement.en: Guy Fawkes, whose mask became a protest symbol, plotted to blow up Parliament.

why: He guarded the gunpowder stockpiled under the House of Lords in 1605.

statement.ru: Закон Венеции велел красить все гондолы в чёрный цвет.
statement.en: A Venetian law required gondolas to be painted black.

why: A sumptuary law of Venice required gondolas to be painted black.

statement.ru: Оливер Кромвель короновался и стал королём Англии.
statement.en: Oliver Cromwell had himself crowned King of England.

why: Parliament offered him the crown in 1657 and he refused it; he ruled as Lord Protector.

statement.ru: Анну Болейн казнили мечом: палача специально вызвали из Франции.
statement.en: Anne Boleyn was beheaded with a sword by an executioner brought from France.

why: Henry brought an expert swordsman from Saint-Omer instead of using the axe.

statement.ru: Покахонтас вышла замуж за капитана Джона Смита.
statement.en: Pocahontas married Captain John Smith.

why: She married the tobacco planter John Rolfe in 1614.

statement.ru: Пуритане в Англии XVII века запретили праздновать Рождество.
statement.en: In the 17th century, England's Puritan rulers banned Christmas.

why: England's Puritan rulers banned Christmas in 1647.

statement.ru: Пиратка Энн Бонни — выдуманная героиня приключенческих романов.
statement.en: The pirate Anne Bonny is a made-up character from adventure novels.

why: She was real: tried with Calico Jack Rackham's crew in Jamaica in 1720; the trial record survives.

statement.ru: Пиратским флотом из сотен кораблей в Китае командовала женщина.
statement.en: A woman commanded a pirate fleet of hundreds of ships in China.

why: Zheng Yi Sao (Ching Shih) led the Guangdong Pirate Confederation, about 400 ships, after 1807.

statement.ru: Когда штурмовали Бастилию, в ней томились сотни узников.
statement.en: When the Bastille was stormed, hundreds of prisoners were held there.

why: It held only seven prisoners on 14 July 1789.

statement.ru: Некоторые фонтаны Версаля включали, лишь когда к ним подходил король.
statement.en: Some fountains at Versailles were turned on only as the king approached.

why: Water was short, so fountaineers whistled to each other and ran each fountain only as the king came by.

statement.ru: Наполеону удалось сбежать с острова Святой Елены.
statement.en: Napoleon managed to escape from the island of Saint Helena.

why: He escaped from Elba in 1815; he died in exile on Saint Helena in 1821.

statement.ru: У Марии-Антуанетты в Версале была своя деревенька с настоящей фермой.
statement.en: Marie Antoinette had her own little village with a working farm at Versailles.

why: The Queen's Hamlet had a farmhouse producing milk and eggs, a dairy, a mill and a dovecote.

statement.ru: Первым хозяином Белого дома был Джордж Вашингтон.
statement.en: George Washington was the first president to live in the White House.

why: It was finished in 1800; John Adams was the first to live there, Washington died in 1799.

statement.ru: После Французской революции во Франции ввели сутки из десяти часов.
statement.en: After the French Revolution, France brought in a day of ten hours.

why: A 1793 decree made decimal time official: 10 hours of 100 minutes.

statement.ru: Бенджамин Франклин, тот, что на купюре в 100 долларов, был президентом США.
statement.en: Benjamin Franklin, the man on the 100-dollar bill, was a US president.

why: A Founding Father and diplomat, never US president (he was President of Pennsylvania).

statement.ru: Два президента США умерли в один день — в 50-летие Декларации независимости.
statement.en: Two US presidents died on the same day: the 50th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence.

why: Jefferson and John Adams both died on 4 July 1826, within hours of each other.

statement.ru: Декларацию независимости США подписали в городе Вашингтоне.
statement.en: The US Declaration of Independence was signed in the city of Washington.

why: It was adopted in Philadelphia in 1776; Washington, D.C. did not exist yet.

statement.ru: Бороду Линкольн отпустил по совету 11-летней девочки.
statement.en: Lincoln grew his beard on the advice of an 11-year-old girl.

why: Grace Bedell, aged 11, wrote to him in 1860 to let his whiskers grow.

statement.ru: Авраам Линкольн был самым низким президентом США.
statement.en: Abraham Lincoln was the shortest US president.

why: At 193 cm (6 ft 4 in) he was the tallest US president.

statement.ru: Мексиканский президент похоронил свою ампутированную ногу с воинскими почестями.
statement.en: A Mexican president buried his amputated leg with full military honours.

why: Santa Anna lost a leg to a French cannonball in 1838 and had it buried with full military honours.

statement.ru: «Пони-экспресс», конная почта Дикого Запада, проработал больше 20 лет.
statement.en: The Pony Express, the Wild West's horseback mail, ran for over 20 years.

why: It ran only 18 months (1860–1861) before the telegraph replaced it.

statement.ru: Великий император Индии Акбар был неграмотным.
statement.en: Akbar, the great emperor of India, was illiterate.

why: He never learned to read or write and had books read to him.

statement.ru: Джека-потрошителя поймали и повесили.
statement.en: Jack the Ripper was caught and hanged.

why: The 1888 Whitechapel killer was never identified.

statement.ru: До четверти ковбоев Дикого Запада были чернокожими.
statement.en: Up to a quarter of Wild West cowboys were Black.

why: Black cowboys made up up to 25 % of range-cattle workers in the 1860s to 1880s.

statement.ru: Во время охоты на ведьм в Европе казнили миллионы людей.
statement.en: Millions of people were executed in Europe's witch hunts.

why: Historians estimate 40,000 to 60,000 executions, not millions.

statement.ru: Знаменитая перестрелка у кораля «О-Кей» длилась около 30 секунд.
statement.en: The famous gunfight at the O.K. Corral lasted about 30 seconds.

why: About thirty shots were fired in thirty seconds (Tombstone, 1881).

statement.ru: Салемских «ведьм» сжигали на кострах.
statement.en: The Salem 'witches' were burned at the stake.

why: In Salem in 1692, 19 people were hanged and one pressed to death; none were burned.

statement.ru: В 1752 году британцы легли спать 2 сентября, а проснулись 14-го.
statement.en: In 1752 the British went to bed on 2 September and woke up on the 14th.

why: Switching to the Gregorian calendar, Wednesday 2 September 1752 was followed by Thursday 14 September.

statement.ru: В викторианской Англии женщины голосовали на выборах в парламент.
statement.en: In Victorian England, women voted in parliamentary elections.

why: British women first got the parliamentary vote in 1918; Victoria died in 1901.

statement.ru: В Лондоне XIX века устраивали вечеринки с разворачиванием мумий.
statement.en: In 19th-century London, people held parties where mummies were unwrapped.

why: Surgeon Thomas Pettigrew was famous for private parties where he unrolled mummies for guests.

statement.ru: Когда в Англии уже ходили пассажирские поезда, в Японии ещё были самураи.
statement.en: When passenger trains already ran in England, Japan still had samurai.

why: England's passenger railways date from 1830; samurai status and stipends were abolished only in the 1870s.

statement.ru: Королевский двор Португалии однажды переехал жить в Бразилию.
statement.en: Portugal's royal court once moved to Brazil.

why: Fleeing Napoleon in 1808, the Portuguese court moved to Rio de Janeiro.
